**B.** Of the two remaining options, B is the only one consistent with the prenuptial agreement. Kathy's valid waiver of all marital rights bars any pretermitted-spouse share, so D fails. That leaves the will controlling: Tommy takes the pasture land, Julie takes the condominium, and the two split the rest. This reverses my earlier answer A, which the team note rules out. B also requires the deed to have failed to pass the condominium to Kathy, and I couldn't establish that firmly.

CONFIDENCE: 60
